instrumentation.force_law: Re-evaluates Newton VBD _eval_soft_ef_contact on the solver's contact arrays and per-contact AVBD penalty/material parameters; sums the opposite body-side force and moment per diagnostic tool.
instrumentation.scope: Offline two-sphere appendix coupon; not integrated into Isaac scene or robot controller.

retained_failures.cause: Warp rejected assigning differently typed return values to repeated underscore temporaries; fixed with distinct local names.

retained_failures.interpretation: The early 13.9 N contact-law peak from this inverted, unstable run is invalid and excluded from the reported force estimates. Raw trial output remains local under the ignored experiment folder.

interpretation_limits: One paired coupon trial is not a validated force-displacement experiment.
The contact force is derived from the solver's own penalty law and state, not independently sensed or calibrated against tissue.
The mesh is a reduced single-organ tetrahedral coupon with spherical tools; no CAD jaws, trocar constraints, bimanual grasp control, or Isaac integration were exercised.
A stable integration and a nonzero contact-law estimate do not establish tissue realism or safe-force thresholds.
privacy: No source video, patient data, credentials, or user personal information is included. Detailed trial arrays remain local and git-ignored.
